subject.title: [Bug] Windows gateway restart leaves orphaned node.exe, two instances contend for session lock causing tool results to render as images in webchat

question: Should maintainers sponsor a Windows live reproduction now, or wait for the reporter to provide listener PID command lines and a redacted malformed JSONL sample?
rationale: The issue is specific and potentially high-impact, but current code contradicts the claimed double-listener chain and this Linux review cannot prove the Windows-only failure mode.

options.title: Wait for reporter proof
options.body: Keep the issue open and ask for Get-NetTCPConnection, Win32_Process command lines for every listener PID, and a small redacted session JSONL excerpt before opening a fix PR.

options.title: Sponsor Windows repro
options.body: Assign an owner to reproduce on Windows with a packaged v2026.6.11 gateway and inspect listener, lock, and transcript state directly.

options.title: Split symptom investigation
options.body: Open a narrower follow-up for the “(see attached image)” conversion path if reporter evidence shows no duplicate gateway listener.

recommendation.title: Wait for reporter proof
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open and ask for Get-NetTCPConnection, Win32_Process command lines for every listener PID, and a small redacted session JSONL excerpt before opening a fix PR.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current history signal across restart, gateway listener, session lock, and tool-result paths points to Vincent Koc’s recent area work.
